adopted_changes: body: CSR begin/next share the edge-ID index width; uint32 only when 2*m fits, size_t fallback otherwise
entries.index_bound_proof: The uint32 branch requires m <= UINT32_MAX/2, hence every CSR degree/prefix/cursor is <= 2*m <= UINT32_MAX-1. The max_size()/2 capacity check and size_t fallback are retained; forced size_t-kernel reference tests passed. On 64-bit targets, begin/next storage falls from 16*n+8 to 8*n+4 bytes for ordinary inputs.
rejected_changes: Uninitialized incident ownership candidate: mixed/unstable large-input results, no consistent gain; retained vector zero initialization.
driver reserve_edges(m): no consistent gain; original driver retained.
entries.measurement_caveat: An initial 9-trial random whole-program set varied with CPU frequency and produced an apparent regression. Only that unresolved concern triggered a 31 alternating-trial stability run of all six large cases; all six final medians improved. All raw measurements remain available.
